title: FBN Fee Dispute Window and Exit Removal Deadline
content:
Two seller-side periods of Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) are fixed per program in calendar days: the window for disputing an FBN fee, counted from the fee's event date, and the deadline for removing remaining units after an exit request, counted from the exit request date.

| Program | Fee dispute window (calendar days) | Exit removal deadline (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| FBN Starter Program | 90 | 60 |
| FBN Core Program | 90 | 60 |
| FBN Growth Program | 90 | 60 |
| FBN Scale Program | 90 | 60 |
| FBN Premier Program | 90 | 90 |
| FBN Enterprise Program | 90 | 90 |

## Notes

- The fee dispute window is 90 days in every program.
- The exit removal deadline is 60 days in FBN Starter, Core, Growth and Scale Programs and 90 days in FBN Premier and Enterprise Programs.
- Illustration (hypothetical dates): an exit request dated 1 April in FBN Core Program reaches its 60-day deadline on 31 May; in FBN Premier Program the 90-day deadline falls on 30 June.
